bootstrap.interval: Descriptive95% percentile; no confirmatory multiplicity/significance claim
bootstrap.pooled: Equal mean of the two family means within each draw
bootstrap.unit: Complete semantic world; all three deliveries and both menus retained

candidate_source.role: Fixed corpus-A raw directions; descriptive transfer only, no felt-state classification

interpretation: Fixed description-candidate transfer and optional behavior only. All assigned denominators retained. Shared whole-world descriptive intervals do not establish a causal regulator, unique construct, owned state, or subjective experience. Failed readiness remains failed; no effect rescues it. Object tables have prior partial exposure; no independent-holdout claim.
optional_choice_association: Not estimated; delivery contrasts are not within-condition prediction.

assessment.exact_rule: Same named two-property four-row candidate table and realized truth; ignores row/column order, delivery, wording, menu, question and sampling seed.
assessment.inclusion_rule: All assigned worlds in every collection with any persisted terminal record or a child with records; failed/partial collections retained without reading outcomes. Reference-check result existence included. Parent/child duplicates unioned semantically.
limitations: Initial local-smoke-v1 source archive unavailable; all48 recorded task/assignment inputs cover all48 assigned trials and were screened directly, without reading answers or preferences.
Local persisted history only; unexported remote, external/pretraining, or human semantic exposure is not covered.
Isomorphic abstract four-row structures recur by design; matching preserves literal named properties/values and does not identify all renamings.
All12 object selections have partial projected-table exposure. This is a development transfer pilot, not independent confirmation or novel-table generalization.
Fresh calls have separate context and do not train model weights; prior study reuse still limits cross-study independence and investigator-heldout claims.
Candidate-pool counts are descriptive only; no outcome-based exclusions or selection changes were made.
assessment.projection_rule: Weaker partial exposure: relational tasks projected to distinct four-row column pairs retain realized truth; target task projections ignore unused truth and compare tables. These three-property tasks are not exact complete-task repeats.

receipt_estimand: Conditional descriptions by selected service only. Fresh rendering, prior reasoning, context length and outcome-dependent active batches differ; receipt-minus-source is not a randomized or causal effect. No receipt interval/admission.
